# Project Phoenix v49.0 Rules Hub scripted effects.
# Generated by gen_v490_game_rules_hub.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_v49_hub_clear_all_vars_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_olympics_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_olympics_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_napoleon_on }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_napoleon_on
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode
	}
}

# Runs on game start (idempotent once oe_v49_hub_synced is set).
oe_v49_hub_sync_game_rules_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced } }
		oe_v49_hub_clear_all_vars_effect = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_synced value = 1 }

		# 1. Alt-History Scale
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_alt_romantic_unleashed }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_alt_strict_historical }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_alt_strict_only value = 1 }
		}

		# 2. Easter Eggs
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_ee_off }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_ee_olympics_off value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_ee_all_on }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_ee_napoleon_on value = 1 }
		}

		# 3. Endgame Boss Crisis
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_armada
					has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_boss_global_coalition
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on value = 1 }
		}

		# 4. World Megaprojects & Great Persons
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_wm_off }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_wonders_off value = 1 }
		}

		# 5. Ruler Portraits
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v49_portraits_vanilla }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_hub_reset_to_lobby_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_synced
	}
	oe_v49_hub_sync_game_rules_effect = yes
}

# Quick presets used by Main Hub (oe_v49_hub.1)
oe_v49_hub_apply_romantic_all_ee_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_synced value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_olympics_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_ee_olympics_off
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_ee_napoleon_on value = 1 }
}

oe_v49_hub_enable_endgame_boss_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_synced value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_endgame_boss_on value = 1 }
}

oe_v49_hub_set_alt_balanced_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_synced value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_strict_only
	}
}
